title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The improved resilience of chronically-affected populations programme in the Central African Republic implemented by Concern Worldwide aims to improve the resilience of the extreme poor communities through enhanced access to high-quality nutrition, health, WASH services, and increased resistance to shocks. The objectives of the programme is to increase food security through increased access to diverse and productive yields; to improve access and management of clean water supplies; and to improve hygiene, health and nutritional practices within vulnerable communities. Communities will also have increased capacity to identify risks, respond and rebound from the impact of crises/shocks.. The support process for the national partner ESPERANCE was launched, enabling the development of a capacity-strengthening plan focused on the needs and priorities identified by both parties. Several working and training sessions were conducted throughout 2025, allowing the partner to improve the quality of fieldwork.
